description: Move 5 to 25 USDC from the account's verified Arc home Safe directly to the SAME owner's Hyperliquid (HyperCore) perps balance via Relay. The Safe must also hold a separate 1.00 USDC Felix network fee: principal plus fee are paid atomically in the same owner-signed transaction. This fee is not refunded if Relay later returns the principal. Relay's quoted deduction is separately limited to 1% of principal; that limit excludes the Felix fee. A brand-new HyperCore account (none exists yet for the owner) also pays Hyperliquid's one-time account activation fee, passed on by Relay (about 1.20 USDC, at most 1.5), deducted from this funding's HyperCore credit, not from the Safe; later fundings do not pay it. It is never accepted automatically: without accept_activation_cost_usd such a funding is refused before anything is prepared, naming the exact cost and the re-call (with a new idempotency_key) that opts in. Before signing, the client independently verifies the Relay order, solver, fee, exact Safe calls and perps account mode, then journals its signature (the Safe nonce comes from Felix, as in the app). After verified perps credit with Relay-attested attribution, the local owner signer completes Hyperliquid trading-agent approval if needed; completed includes hyperliquid_status:ready. If funding succeeds but approval does not, venue_funded:true and venue_usable:false mean resume this same idempotency_key and arguments to finish approval without another funding transfer. Reuse the same idempotency_key after a timeout; never create a new funding to work around an uncertain outcome.

accept_activation_cost_usd.description: Optional, owner opt-in: the most the owner accepts (USDC, more than 0 and at most 1.5, at most six decimals) for Hyperliquid's one-time activation of a HyperCore account that does not exist yet, deducted from this funding's credit. Pass only after the owner agreed to the exact cost a refusal named. Part of this idempotency_key: a resume must repeat the same value.

amount_usd.description: Exact transfer principal, 5 to 25 USDC, at most six decimals. Excludes the additional 1.00 USDC Felix fee.

idempotency_key.description: Required workflow replay key. Reuse it to resume this exact funding.

minimum_credit_usd.description: Optional: refuse unless Relay signs at least this perps credit.

name: fund_hypercore_from_arc
